title: Higher-Order Components
description: Learn the HOC pattern for reusing component logic across your React application.
longDescription: Higher-Order Components (HOCs) are an advanced technique for reusing component logic. In this module, you will learn how to create, use, and compose HOCs to build cleaner and more maintainable React applications. You will explore practical examples and understand when to use HOCs versus modern alternatives like custom hooks.
whatYouLearn: Understand what Higher-Order Components are and how they work
Create reusable HOCs for cross-cutting concerns like authentication and logging
Apply HOC naming conventions and displayName for better debugging
Compose multiple HOCs to build powerful component enhancements
Compare HOC patterns with modern React hooks and choose the right approach
